issues.title: NG9-3 B207 Trionic 8 replacement is not a plug-in used-module swap
issues.cause: Factory engine control module is a programmable processor-based control system; independent specialists clone vehicle program/security data when original can be read.
symptoms: Inoperative ECM diagnosis requires proof of no internal circuit, power or CAN fault
Unprogrammed used module will not necessarily start target vehicle
issues.diagnosis_summary: Perform original WIS power/ground/network/ECM diagnosis and determine if original communicates and data is recoverable before donor purchase or cloning.
issues.correction_summary: Verify programming support and donor compatibility by VIN; one quoted vendor requires functioning communication with original and both ECUs in hand.
limits: No universal T8 ECU failure frequency proven
Seller services are not manufacturer-approved interchange
A non-communicating module may have separate more complex solutions that have not been studied

issues.title: Original 9-5 B235 T7 cassette is a separately serviced ignition component, not equivalent to a Trionic 8 ECU failure
issues.cause: Saab WIS distinguishes discrete ignition discharge module service from replacement of entire ECM, and manufacturer service support continues through part 32022255.
symptoms: Misfire/ignition fault requires diagnosis before cassette replacement
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use factory extended Trionic 7 ignition discharge module diagnostics before parts ordering.
issues.correction_summary: Cassette replacement follows original factory mechanical installation and seal/connector requirements; check exact VIN application and supply.
limits: No inferred failure frequency or life expectancy
Not a complete Trionic 7 ECM service procedure or guarantee of U.S. inventory
